brief: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching.

requirements.requirement: One drawer and one spike, both at the very same corner of the same cell, touching
requirements.evidence: Build has piece:0,0,0;half-n which offers drawer socket s (south cut face) and spike junction 0,0|0,1|1,0 at its southeast corner. Placing drawer alone succeeded (drawer:0#0,0#cut), placing spike alone succeeded (spike:0#0,0|0,1|1,0), but batch apply of both returned SPIKE_CLASH: 'a drawer (south half) fills this corner of the junction, where the spike would stand. Take the drawer off, or use another junction.' Configurator rule prevents co-location; no alternative socket allows same corner touching.

finish.summary: Requirement is not buildable under current configurator rules. Drawer on half-n south cut face physically occupies the same junction where spike would stand. Tested individually both succeed, together refused with SPIKE_CLASH. No mesh-verified build can satisfy 'same corner touching' without violating placement rules.
